summary: Lists files excluded from collection builds by default and shows using build_ignore glob patterns in galaxy.yml to exclude more, supported since Ansible 2.10.
questions: Which files are left out of a collection build automatically?
How do I exclude a folder and all tar.gz files from my collection build?

answer_card.title: Exclude files with build_ignore
answer_card.answer_md:
Excluded by default: `galaxy.yml`, `*.pyc`, `*.retry`, `tests/output`, previously built tarballs in the root, and VCS dirs like `.git/`.

Add more with glob patterns (`*`, `?`, `[seq]`, `[!seq]`):
```yaml
build_ignore:
- playbooks/sensitive
- '*.tar.gz'
```
Requires Ansible 2.10+.
